Quick:

Frequently Asked Questions

Find instant answers to common questions regarding trip registration, payments, train details, and tickets.

Can I register for a trip without paying immediately?

Yes! TripPay allows registration with ₹0 advance payment. You can secure your slot immediately and submit your payments in installments later.

Where does Train 12617 Mangala Lakshadweep Express halt?

Train 12617 departs Ernakulam Jn (ERS) at 13:25 and travels via Tirur (TIR) at 15:39, Kozhikode (CLT) at 16:27, Kannur, Mangaluru Jn, Goa (Madgaon), Panvel (Mumbai), Nashik Road, Bhopal, Jhansi, Gwalior, and reaches Agra Cantt (AGC) at 10:40 on Day 3 before terminating at Hazrat Nizamuddin (NZM) at 13:35.

You can also view the full route & halts timeline in the "Train Route & Timings" tab!

How do I get my official Boarding Pass and PDF?

Go to the "Your Passes & Tickets" tab on the homepage, enter your registered Phone Number, and your boarding pass will appear instantly. You can download it as an image, print it as a PDF ticket, or share it on WhatsApp.

Can I install TripPay on my iPhone, Android, or PC?

Yes! Click the green "Install App" button in the top navigation header. On iOS Safari, tap the Share icon and choose "Add to Home Screen". On Android and Desktop, click Install when prompted to run TripPay as a native app.

How long does payment approval take?

Trip coordinators review and verify UPI transaction IDs or cash receipts within 1 to 24 hours. Your Boarding Pass will update automatically once verified.

Confidential Student Direct Channel

Your message will be sent directly and privately to the Trip Boss Admin. General coordinators or other students will NOT have access to your feedback.
